intro: To assess a study, it locates the question, the sample, the data collection method and the stated limitations.

bloques.titulo: To assess a study, it locates the question, the sample, the data collection method and the stated limitations.
texto: To assess a study, it locates the question, the sample, the data collection method and the stated limitations.
A large sample does not in itself guarantee that it represents the entire population; it checks who was left out.

frases.ru: Авторы опросили 840 жителей из шести районов и отдельно описали метод отбора.
frases.es: Los autores encuestaron a 840 residentes de seis distritos y describieron el método de selección.
frases.en: The authors surveyed 840 residents of six districts and described the selection method.

frases.ru: В исследование не вошли жители пригородов, поэтому выводы относятся только к городской выборке.
frases.es: El estudio no incluyó a los residentes de las afueras, así que sus conclusiones se refieren solo a la muestra urbana.
frases.en: The study did not include the residents on the outskirts, so its conclusions refer only to the urban sample.

opciones.texto: No residents from the outskirts participated
opciones.explicacion: The second sentence explicitly delimits the scope of the sample.

opciones.texto: Not indicated how many people participated
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
